Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this cracking first game of the three-match ODI series between South Africa and England. The second ODI will be played on Sunday, 29th of January and that game will start at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). Do join us for the build-up of that game. Cheers!

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says that the things did change quickly. Adds they got the ball to turn, put on the pressure and that got them back in the game. Informs that they could've got it excess of 300 but the wicket got slower which made it difficult. Mentions that they felt that the score was below par but it proved to be enough in the end. Adds that the opening stand for England were off to a flier even better than their owns. Informs that every player played a role in this chase. All the bowlers gave it thier all on the field. Adds that they will take the win as they were in desperate need for points.

Sisanda Magala is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he is very happy considering the position they were in and to pull off this win is a great thing for them. Tells that he would be bowling in the middle overs was communicated earlier to him and says that his plan was to bowl stump-to-stump and keep it simple. Mentions that in the first innings, the bouncers were sticking a bit on the pitch and they tried to use that.

Jos Buttler, the skipper of England in is for a chat. He thinks that they played excellent cricket but is disappointed as they gave away the game after a solid opening stand. He informs that they need to keep going and face the challenges head on. Credits South Africa for their solid comeback as they took wickets at regular intervals. Ends by saying he is really gutted that the could not get over the line.
Time for the Presentation.

In the first half, South Africa started on a brisk note but most of their batters failed to convert their starts but Rassie van der Dussen stood up along with Miller to take them to a par total. Sam Curran was brilliant with the ball for the visitors and they would have backed themselves to chase this total but South Africa showed great fighting spirit and pulled of a memorable win here.

England, well, their philosophy to keep going for their shots might have backfired here. However, that is how they play and that has brought them success over the years but not in this game. They had a brilliant opening stand of 146 and it looked like the game will finish within 40 overs. However, they lost wickets at regular intervals once that opening stand was broken and England kept going for their shots even though the required rate was well below 6 runs per over and once Buttler departed in the 37th over, South African bowling attack turned out too good for the lower order batters.

South Africa looked down and out when England cruised to 146 in the 20th over with all 10 wickets in hand. However, Magala started the fightback and got rid of Malan first and Nortje too joined him with his rapid bullets as South Africa started finding wickets at regular intervals. From 146-0, England were reduced to 152-3. However, the real downfall started when Rabada got rid of Roy who was playing brilliantly and then despite England batting deep, South African pacers continued to charge in and produced incredible spells to pull off an incredible victory in the end. Nortje and Magala were the pick of the bowlers with seven wickets between them and Rabada too got two important wickets. Once again, South Africa have shown why they are one of the best bowling units in the world.

WOW! What a cracker of a game we have witnessed here! Absolutely incredible scenes here at Mangaung Oval as South Africa have clinched this thriller and have shown here what that World Cup qualification means to them. They have pulled off an absolute heist here and it is on the back of sheer fighting spirit and some top-notch skills!

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Tabraiz Shamsi picks up the final wicket and he takes off here into his celebration. It is looped up, on leg stump. Olly Stone tries to flick it away but it flies off the leading edge to the right of the bowler. Tabraiz Shamsi moves to his right in a flash. He fumbles but accepts it on the second bite. SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE GAME BY 27 RUNS.
A dot now! On off, defended out.
Good length, on the pads. Stone tucks it to square leg for a single. These singles aren't helping England's cause here.
It is full length, tailing into the pads. Olly Stone gets an inside edge on his pads.
A short ball, on off. Adil Rashid pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full length, outside off. Adil Rashid punches it to point.
A short ball, wide of off. Adil Rashid tries to throw the kitchen sink at it but only connects with thin air.
Back of a length, wide of off. Adil Rashid stands back and cuts it to deep point for a brace.
Length ball, on off. Olly Stone nudges it to mid-wicket.
Olly Stone is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh, Anrich Nortje gets a wicket and England are nine down now! What a come back this has been from South Africa! They are pumped up and rightly so, the World Cup qualification is on the line. On the shorter side, around off. Too quick for Archer as he awkwardly tries to work it towards the leg side. However, he only manages to get an outside edge to backward point where Heinrich Klaasen takes a very important catch. The crowd goes wild!
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: Wow! A sharp bouncer, around off. Archer somehow manages to evade it.
Short of good length, on off at 146 kph. Archer defends it towards the leg side. The home crowd is getting right behind their boys here!
On the shorter side, on off. Archer fends it from his crease.
Back of a length, on middle. Rashid works it to deep square leg for a single.
Jofra Archer is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Rabada gets a big wicket of Sam Curran in his last delivery of this game and England are eight down now with 33 runs still needed! Shortish and outside off. Probably not that short to cut and it nips away a bit too. Curran tries to cut it but gets an outside edge to Quinton de Kock behind the stumps who takes a regulation catch and South Africa are still in it. In fact they are slightly ahead in this game now!
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs it short again on middle at 135 kph. Curran decides to duck under it.
Bowls a short delivery on off. Curran lets it go.
Back of a length, around off at 137 kph. Rashid steers it towards third man for a single.
On the shorter side, on middle. Curran works it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Curran dabs it onto the turf and it goes just away from the stumps.
Back of a length and outside off. Rashid leaves it alone.
FOUR! What a response from Rashid! Nortje bowls it full and on middle. Rashid clears his front leg and heaves it wide of mid on for a boundary.

NO BALL! Oh, my word! This is heart break for South Africa! Nortje bowls a sharp bouncer on off. Rashid is caught off guard and tries to evade the ball but the ball hits his bat and loops up in the air. The fielder catches it at short third man but Nortje has overstepped here and Rashid will survive. A Free Hit coming up too...
Back of a length, around off. Rashid tries to punch it but gets an under edge that goes off the gloves off Quinton de Kock to third man for a couple.
Lands it on a length, on off. Rashid fends it from his crease.
Back of a length, around off. Curran steers it towards third man for a single. Some serious gas here from Nortje!
Oh, that was close! Curran backs away and Nortje bowls a yorker, around off. Curran fails to get a bat on it and the ball misses the off pole by a whisker!
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this game.
Lands safely! It is a short ball, on the bodyline. The ball gets big on him. Sam Curran stays deep inside his crease to block it away. The ball lobs off the top of the blade. They take a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Rashid works it to fine leg for a single.
Good length and on off. Rashid hangs back and defends it away.
Adil Rashid defends this length ball solidly.
A single now as this is pushed to covers.

The crowd thinks it is OUT! But they forgot that it is a Free Hit. Rabada bangs in a short one on off. Adil Rashid goes for the hook shot. It takes the outside edge and goes to deep square leg. The fielder in the deep makes no mistake but throws it back quickly in play. One taken.
NO BALL! A short ball, on off. Adil Rashid dabs it out to point. The umpire signals a no ball for over-stepping. Free Hit to follow.
Length and around off. Rashid dabs it down to third man for a single. Adil Rashid is off the mark instantly.
Adil Rashid is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Anrich Nortje gets his second wicket. Some faces have already dropped in the English dressing room. They are falling like a pack of cards now. Nortje bangs in a short ball, on off. David Willey looks to hook it away but catches a thick outside edge. It flies out to the off side where David Miller takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on middle and leg. Willey flicks it to the leg side but not in the gap.
Anrich Nortje dishes a in-tucking delivery, full and on middle. Willey gets an inside edge on the pads.
Good length, on middle and leg, angled in. Willey eases it out back to the bowler.
Length and on off. Curran shuffles inside the line and flicks it to the leg side.

FOUR! He connects this time and gets a boundary. Back of a length, on leg. David Willey pulls it over square leg for a cracking boundary. 15 runs off the over. England are still in the game here. 50 runs needed off 72 balls.
Two dots in a row now! Back of a length, on middle and leg. It flies off the deck. David Willey tries to heave it across the line but misses. He gets beaten on the inside edge.
A bit short, on off. Willey dabs it out to the off side.
FOUR! Smacked! David Willey gets off the mark in a fine manner. Overpitched, wide of off. David Willey drives it past extra cover for four runs.
Full length, on leg stump. Curran goes back and lofts it over covers for a single.

SIX! All the way! Sam Curran is saying that he is still out there to get his side over the line. It is pitched up, just outside off. Sam Curran gets under it and tonks it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Back of a length, outside off. David Willey leaves it alone for keeper.
David Willey is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Anrich Nortje gets the big fish now. Jos Buttler departs on 36. The skipper cannot take his side over the victory line here. Good-length ball, in the channel. Jos Buttler looks to punch it through the line but only gets a thick outside edge. Quinton de Kock takes a strong catch behind the sticks. South Africa have revived hope now.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: Two dots in a row! A length ball, on fifth stump. Jos Buttler looks to punch it through the line but misses.
An inswinging delivery, full and on off. Jos Buttler defends it to mid off.
Good length, on top of off. Sam Curran waits for it and guides it down to third man for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Jos Buttler hangs back and defends it out to point for one.
A bumper now, on middle. Curran ducks under it without any hesitation.
Good length, on top of off. Sam Curran gets it towards mid on off the inner half.
Sam Curran hangs back and drives this full abll to mid off. Does not find the gap.
Jos Buttler stays back and nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Much fuller, on off. Jos Buttler defends it out to mid off.
Good length, on the body. Sam Curran tucks it to the leg side for one.
Sam Curran knocks this length ball to deep point for a single.
Fuller and on off. Sam Curran presses forward and defends it out solidly.
It is full and on off. Jos Buttler lobs it to mid off for one run.
Two Leg Byes! A length ball, on the pads. Jos Buttler misses his flick. It goes down to fine leg off the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Goes full, on middle and leg. Curran flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Jos Buttler stands back and punches this length ball through covers for one.
Back of a length, on the body. Jos Buttler swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Sam Curran stays back to this short ball and punches it past backward point for a single.
Sam Curran walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sisanda Magala is turning the game on its head. England now has half of their side back in the hut. Magala goes short once again, outside off. Moeen Ali goes for the pull but this time the ball flies off the top-edge and flies to deep square leg. Aiden Markram in the deep takes a solid catch. Is this the opening that can allow South Africa to make inroads in this game?
Commentary.Howout: c Rassie van der Dussen b Sisanda Magala

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! It is a short ball, outside off. Ali stands tall and swats it over mid on for a cracking boundary.

Magala serves a length ball, on off. Buttler taps it gently to mid off and crosses. Temba Bavuma scores a direct-hit at the non-striker's end. The South African fielders think they have got their man here. The third umpire though confirms that Jos Buttler is well inside the crease.
Back of a length, outside off. Ali punches it through point for a single.
Fuller and on off. Buttler gets it to mid on off the inner half.
WIDE! Full, this is spilled down leg. Buttler tries to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
A length ball, on off. Ali taps it to mid off and scampers for a quick single. Temba Bavuma rushes and has a shy at the non-striker's end but is wayward.
Back of a length, on off. Ali tries to pull it away but wears it on his body.
Parnell spills a length ball, down leg. Buttler tucks it to square leg and crosses.
Jos Buttler hangs back and tucks this length ball on the leg side.
A length ball, outside off. Ali eases it to third man for one.
Back of a length, in the channel. Ali dabs it out to point for one run.
Length and on off, blocked out solidly.
WIDE! Kagiso Rabada dishes a sharp bouncer, on middle. Ali ducks under it. Quinton de Kock leaps and collects it with one hand.
Kagiso Rabada dishes a length ball, on off. Ali blocks it out solidly.
On off, defended out watchfully.
Back of a length, on off. Jos Buttler pulls it had. Shouts of catch it but it lands safely. One taken.
A length ball, on off. Ali dabs it down to third man for one.
FOUR! Up and over! It is full and on off. Jos Buttler lofts it over the bowler's head for four runs.
Jos Buttler now eases this full ball to covers.
Good length, in the channel. Ali taps it to point and scampers across for a quick single. Jos Buttler is fast between the wickets and makes it safely to the other end.
Wayne Parnell now serves it full, angled into the pads. Ali tucks it to the leg side but not in the gap.
On a length, around off. Ali stays back and defends it out to the off side watchfully.
A length ball, on off. Jos Buttler dabs it out to point and crosses.
Bangs it short again on off. Buttler pulls it to deep square leg for a single. 97 needed now from 120 balls!
FOUR! Good shot! Short and on off. Buttler pulls and pulls it well in front of square for a boundary.
Hits the length hard again, on off. Ali defends it with soft hands towards the off side and takes a quick single.
Serves it on a length, on middle. Ali defends it nicely back to the bowler.
On a length, around off. Ali fends it off the outside half of his blade to backward point.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh, Roy holes out in the deep! He absolutely smashed it but finds the fielder in the deep. However, it has been a speical knock from the dynamic opener and gets a standing ovation as he walks back off the field. This is short and on off. Roy pulls it hard to deep square leg. It goes flat and seems to be travelling all the way but Parnell in the deep runs to his left and takes a very fine catch to send back dangerous Roy back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Wayne Parnell b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls it fuller and on middle. Roy works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle and turning in. Roy tries to reverse-sweep it but misses.
Loopy delivery on middle. Buttler works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller and on off. Buttler drives it to the cover-point fielder.
FOUR! Another boundary! Powerful shot! Shamsi continues to flight the ball, on off. Buttler slams it down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Shamsi continues to leak runs! Tossed up, around off. Buttler drills it through extra cover for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. It is a slower delivery and Roy who tries to guide it towards third man gets beaten.
On a length, on off. Roy fends it towards covers. Bit of extra bounce there!
Shortish and on off. Buttler punches it off the inside half of his blade to mid on for a single.
Back of a length and outside off. Buttler tries to slap it away but mistimes it to covers.
Back of a length, angling into off. Buttler blocks it right under his eyes.
Short and outside off. Buttler tries to cut it but misses.
Touch shorter and on leg. Buttler clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 10 runs from the over!
Serves it fuller and on off. Roy drives it to mid off for a single.
SIX! Powerful shot this! Shamsi tosses this one up on off. Roy slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Tosses it up on middle. Roy tries to clip it towards the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Shamsi appeals but the umpire is not interested.
Goes fuller and on middle. Roy works it to mid-wicket this time.
Serves it fuller and on middle. Roy sweeps but gets a top edge. The ball goes aerially towards deep backward square leg and couple of runs are taken.
A slower bouncer on off. Roy pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Bowls a yorker on middle. Buttler digs it out to point for a single.
Smart bowling this! A slower fullish delivery, outside off. Buttler tries to tonk it down the ground but misses.
Short and on middle. Buttler tries to pull it but misses. Good gas from Magala!
WIDE! Serves it fuller but errs in line and drifts down the leg side. Buttler tries to flick it but misses.
Back of a length, on off. Buttler blocks it solidly towards mid off.
Goes fuller and on middle. Buttler clips it to fine leg for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Roy dabs it calmly onto the turf.

FOUR! That brings up a fantastic hundred for Jason Roy! He was in lot of pressure coming into this game with not much runs behind him but he has shown it once again what impact he can make when he gets going. This is short and on middle. Roy pulls and pulls it nicely in the gap as the ball runs away towards the square leg fence. A fluent knock from the right-handed opener!
In the air...but just over Miller at covers! Back of a length and outside off. Buttler plays a check-drive and hits it uppishly just over covers for a single.
Short and angling into leg. Roy pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Roy works it to mid-wicket this time.
Back of a length and outside off. Roy punches it through covers for a couple.
On a length and outside off. Roy drives it off the outside half of his blade to deep point for a single.
Nice full delivery on middle at 136 kph. Roy somehow manages to clip it to mid-wicket.
Buttler has been hit on his helmet! So, it is time for a mandatory concussion test here. The physio is out and Buttler looks fine to continue as he gets his helmet changed.
Short and on middle. Buttler tries to pull it but gets a top edge onto his helmet. The ball deflects towards third man and a single is taken.
Goes fuller and angling into middle. Buttler tries to drive it away but the ball goes off the inside half of his blade to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Buttler fends it towards the off side.
Serves a length delivery on middle. Roy pushes it to mid on for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Buttler rides the bounce and dabs it towards the point fielder.
Shortish and on off. Roy tries to pull it but is hurried by this short one and just about manages to pull it to square leg for a single.
Short and outside off. Roy tries to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball goes aerially towards deep mid-wicket and the batters take two.
Shortish and outside off. Roy punches it to the cover fielder.
On a good length and outside off. Roy leaves it alone carefully.
Shortish and outside off. Roy punches it through covers for a couple.
Back of a length, around off. Buttler rides the bounce and dabs it towards the point fielder. Just a run from the over and a big wicket too.
A fullish delivery, around off. Buttler drives it to the cover fielder.
On a length, on off. Buttler fends it towards the off side nicely.
Jos Buttler walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! South Africa get another and now they are surely back in this game! Harry Brook departs for a duck on his ODI debut! Magala lands it on a length, on off and gets this one to nip back in sharply. Brook who tries to work it towards the leg side, misses as he plays all around this delivery. It looks dead straight as soon as it hits his pads and the umpire too raises his finger after Magala makes a loud appeal. Brook has a chat with Roy but decides to walk back without taking the review.
Lands it on a length, on off. Brook defends it right under his eyes.
Serves it fuller and on middle. Roy works it to fine leg for a single.
On a good length and outside off. Brook leaves it alone nicely.
Harry Brook is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! One brings two for South Africa and Ben Duckett departs! Short and outside off. Some extra pace and bounce from Nortje there and Ben Duckett who tries to cut it gets an outside edge. The ball goes back to Quinton de Kock behind the stumps and he takes it safely to bring some hope back for the home side. Can South Africa capitalise on this opening?
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off. Roy cuts it firmly to deep point for a single.
On a length, on off. Ben Duckett works it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Roy tries to punch it but gets an inside edge that goes past stumps to fine leg for a single.
Lands it on a length, on off. Ben Duckett fends it towards the off side and takes a single.
Full length, on off. Roy defends it back to the bowler. A successful over by Magala comes to an end.
Serves it fuller and outside off. Ben Duckett drives it uppishly off the outside edge of his blade over gully for a single as the fielder in the deep cuts it off.
Shortish and outside off. Ben Duckett tries to cut it but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sisanda Magala finds the breakthrough. Just what the Proteas were after since the last 19 overs. It is a short ball, wide outside off. Malan looks to pull it away but only manages to get a top-edge on it. The ball goes straight up in the air. It goes to mid off. Temba Bavuma settles under it and takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Sisanda Magala

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, on fifth stump. Malan eases it down to third man and takes two runs.
Good length, wide of off. Malan looks to chase it but misses.
Fuller and on leg. Roy clips it to mid-wicket. An expensive over from Tabraiz Shamsi comes to an end. 18 runs off the over.
A single now as this is played down to long off.
A low full toss, on leg. Roy smacks it down to long on for a single.
SIX! Jason Roy makes the most of the Free Hit here. It is full and on off. Roy makes room and smokes it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Flatter and on off. Malan knocks it to mid on and crosses. The umpire signals a no ball as the bowler oversteps. You do not want to see this as a spinner. A Free Hit to follow.
FOUR! Good-looking shot. Dawid Malan leans in this full delivery, outside off and creams it through covers for a boundary.

FOUR! A freebie! A waist-high full toss, on off. Malan whips it across the line and it races away to the fence. Dawid Malan gets to his fifty. He raises his bat in appreciation but knows that his job is just half done.
A length ball, on off. This one spits off the deck. Roy is surprised by the extra bounce as he defends it out awkwardly.
Jason Roy gets on his front foot and defends it out to safety.
A length ball, outside off. Malan drives it to deep point for one.
Jason Roy drives this full ball from outside off to the off side.
Sisanda Magala angles in a length ball, on the pads. Roy nudges it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, wide of off. Malan cuts it through cover-point for a single.

Drinks break. England are bossing this game at the moment! Both Roy and Malan got off to a flier and unlike South Africa who lost wickets after a brisk start, English openers have not thrown it away. South Africa need to find solutions and find them quickly otherwise this game seems to be drifting away from them quite quickly here. Can the Proteas fightback here? Let’s find out as Sisanda Magala is into the attack now.
Darted on the pads, Roy clips it to deep square leg for two runs as he gets it through the gap once again.
FOUR! Jason Roy races away to 75 from just 55 balls. It is full and on middle. Roy gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for four more.
FOUR! This is full, drifting down leg. Roy sweeps it fine and gets a boundary.
Fuller, outside off. Jason Roy goes for the reverse sweep. He hits it past backward point but Heinrich Klaasen is up to the task and makes a stop with one hand.
This one is sliding down leg. Roy clips it to deep square leg for a couple now.
Tabraiz Shamsi goes full and on leg. Malan nudges it down the track for one run.
Jason Roy cuts this short ball to sweeper cover and collect a brace. These two batters are scoring for fun at the moment.
FOUR! Exceptional timing this time. A short ball, wide of off. Roy goes back and crunches it past backward point for four.
SIX! BANG! Back of a length, outside off. Jason Roy swivels and dispatches it over the square leg fence for a maximum. This also brings the 100-run stand for England.
Three singles on the trot! Back of a length, outside off. Malan cuts it hard to deep point for a single.
Jason Roy dabs this length ball down to short third for a single.
Anrich Nortje serves a length ball, on the pads. Malan tucks it to square leg for a single.
This is short, on off. Malan pulls it down to long on for an easy single.
Tabraiz Shamsi serves a loopy one, around off. Shamsi taps it out watchfully.
Fuller, on leg. Roy reverse hits it to deep point for one more.
Around leg, Malan tucks it to mid-wicket and crosses.
A bit short, wide of off,turning away. Malan reaches out and helps it to cover.
Darted on the pads, Roy clips it to the leg side for one.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack now. Can he break this partnership?
A sharp bouncer, on middle. Malan sways away from the line.

Jason Roy gets his FIFTY! His first one in South Africa and he surely needed a knock to boost his confidence. It is full and on off. Roy pushes it out to point for one run. The dressing room appreciates this knock from Roy.
FOUR! This one is hit like a bullet. Back of a length, on off. Roy swivels and swats it through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Swing and a miss! Length ball, this lands on outside off and shapes further away off the deck. Jason Roy tries to defend it out but misses.
This full ball is driven to sweeper cover for two runs.
FOUR! Jason Roy serves a full-length ball, on middle and leg, angling in. Roy clears his front leg and flicks it over mid on for four runs.
Four dots to end the over. Full and on leg. Malan tucks it to mid-wicket. A good comeback by Markram as he goes just for three runs now after conceding 15 off his first one.
Shroter, in the channel. Malan taps it towards backward point.
Full again, on fifth stump. Malan strokes it to the off side.
Aiden Markram goes full and on off. Malan blocks it to point.
Shorter, wide of off. Malan cuts it late towards deep point. The batters take two runs.
Loops it up, full and outside off. Roy eases it to long off for a single.
Length and on top of off. Malan blocks it out watchfully.

Anrich Nortje has done well to pull things back after going for a boundary off the very first delivery. It is a length ball, on middle and leg. Dawid Malan is cramped for room this time as he dabs it away.
Jason Roy now takes a single as he swivels on his back foot and pulls it behind square on the leg side.
A dot now! Anrich Nortje dishes a full-length ball, swinging in at 145 clicks. Roy defends it out.
On a length, on off. Malan taps it gently to mid off and takes off to the other end.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Dawid Malan greets Anrich Nortje with a fine boundary here. It is a pace-up delivery, full sliding down leg. Malan tickles it down to fine leg for four runs.
Change from both ends now! Anrich Nortje is into the attack now.
A single now as this is tapped to the off side. 15 runs off the over. England are off to a rollicking start here.

FOUR! Dawid Malan joins the party now. He gets a bit fortunate.It is tossed up, outside off. Malan tries to drive it through the line but gets a thick outside edge. It stays low and runs down to the third man fence.
This full ball is swept to deep square leg for one.
SIX! BOOM! Aiden Markram goes full and wide outside off. Jason Roy frees his arm and smokes it over the wide long off fence.
Another single now as this full ball is defended to point. This is brilliant running.
Floated and full, on leg. Roy nudges it to the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Aiden Markram starts with a loosener. This is spilled down leg. Roy lets it be. Wide called.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over. It is time for some spin now as Aiden Markram comes into the attack now.
On a length, around off. Roy steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off at 136 kph. Roy fends it towards the off side.
Short of good length, around off. Malan steers it towards third man for a single.
Short and outside off. Malan lets it go.
On the shorter side, around off. Roy punches it to cover-point for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Roy works it to backward square leg.
Goes fuller and on middle. Malan pushes it gently to mid on.
Back of a length and outside off again. Malan tries to punch it away but misses.
Shortish again and outside off. Malan cuts again but straight to the point fielder.
FOUR! Malan has been timing the ball superbly today! Short and wide outside off. Malan cuts it past point for a lovely boundary.
Angles a length delivery on middle. Malan tucks it to mid-wicket this time.
Back of a length, on leg. Roy works it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Roy dabs it to backward point and takes a single.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! On a length and outside off. Roy gets on the top of the bounce as he drives it through covers for a lovely boundary.
A slower low full toss on off. Roy drives it to mid off this time.
Back of a length, around off. Roy dabs it towards backward point.
Shorter in length, on off. Roy blocks it off the back foot.
Short of good length and outside off. Roy tries to push it first then pulls his bat back from the line of the ball.
Another really good over, just one run from it! Back of a length, outside off. Malan punches it to the point fielder.
On the shorter side, on middle. Roy pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Roy punches it to covers this time.
Back of a length, on off. Roy tries to pull it but gets an inside edge past stumps. Quinton de Kock makes a good stop diving to his left.
Serves it full and on middle. Roy works it to mid on, fails to find the gap again.
Nice full delivery on off. Roy drives it to mid off with some good timing.
Goes fuller and on middle. Roy works it to deep backward square leg for a single. Good over, just 2 from it!
A slower length delivery, outside off. Roy cuts it left of point where Aiden Markram dives and stops it.
Short of good length, around off. Roy dabs it towards the point fielder.
Back of a length, on off. Roy blocks it off the back foot.
A fuller delivery, outside off. Roy drives it off the outside half of his blade to point.
Back of a length, around off. Malan steers it towards third man for a single.
Short and outside off. Malan cuts it to third man for a single,
Serves another good-length delivery, outside off. Malan leaves it alone.
FOUR! What a reply from Malan! Excellent shot! On a length and outside off. Malan drives it through cover-point on the up for a boundary.
Again a superb delivery! Back of a length and outside off. The ball shapes away with good bounce and Malan who tries to punch it gets beaten again.
Beaten again! A fullish delivery and outside off. Malan goes for a big booming drive but gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball shapes away.
Lands it on a good length and outside off. The ball shapes away and beats Malan as he has a poke at it away from his body.
Goes fuller and on off. Roy drives it to mid off this time.
On a length, around off. Malan steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length, on off. Malan defends it nicely again.
Back of a length, around off. Malan dabs it towards the point fielder.
A fuller delivery on off. Roy drives it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Poor bowling this! The fine leg is inside the cricle and Rabada bowls a length delivery on leg. Roy just tucks it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Roy pushes it left of mid off for a single.
On a length, on off. Roy defends it towards mid off this time.
FOUR! Another boundary! On a length, on middle. Roy works it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Just pure timing again!
FOUR! Boundaries continue to flow here for England! A fullish delivery, around off. roy drives it off the outside half of his blade through cover-point for a boundary.
Good delivery! On a good length, around off. This is angled across the right-hander and beats Roy as he tries to defend it.
On a length, on middle and nipping back in. Roy tries to clip it but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Angles a length delivery on off. Malan blocks it off the front foot. England are off to a flier here!
FOUR! Another lovely shot from Malan! Bowls an overpitched delivery, around off. Malan leans forward and creams it through covers for a boundary.
On a length and around off. Malan fends it towards the point fielder.
FOUR! Wonderful timing again from Malan! Angles a full delivery on middle. Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Malan fends it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Nicely played! Rabada starts off with a fuller delivery on middle from 'round the wicket. Malan waits for it and works it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Kagiso Rabada to start from the other end.
Angles a length delivery on middle and leg. Malan works it to deep backward square leg. Rabada in the deep runs to his right, dives full length and saves a run for his side. Three taken.
On a good length and outside off. Shaping away from the left-hander and Malan gets an inside edge onto his pad as looks to drive it away.
Serves it fuller and on off. Roy drives it left of mid off for a single.
FOUR! Roy and England are underway in style! Goes fuller and on middle. Roy flicks and flicks it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A fullish delivery and shaping into middle. Roy fends it off the front foot to mid off.
Parnell starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery on off. Roy works it to the leg side.
